title: Article 48A — Protection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wildlife

content.overview: Article 48A directs the State to endeavour to protect and improve the environment and to safeguard the forests and wildlife of the country. Environmental regulation is primarily statutory and, in rights litigation, often linked to Article 21 jurisprudence as developed by the courts.

sections.heading: Directive and statutes
sections.body: Article 48A supports environmental policy. Substantive duties and remedies appear in environmental statutes, rules, and judicial orders. Verify the implementing framework for the specific harm alleged.

sections.heading: Link to Article 21
sections.body: Courts have developed environmental dimensions of the right to life under Article 21 in decided cases. Argue from those authorities and statutes; do not invent holdings or paragraph numbers.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Identify the regulator, the statutory breach, and the forum. Use Article 48A to explain policy coherence where relevant.
